# Switch lever: an iron handle with a cream knob, pivot at its foot. One game bone per junction: the game
# tilts it towards the lane the switch sends the cart down. Up Z; the knob leans with roll.
new
material new Iron --base-color 0.125 0.157 0.239 --no-slot
material new Knob --base-color 0.984 0.969 0.953 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Handle --size 1 --location 0 0 0.25
scale 0.09 0.09 0.5
apply --scale
material assign Iron
add mesh uv-sphere --name Knob --segments 6 --rings 4 --radius 0.11 --location 0 0 0.55
material assign Knob
select all
shade flat
export lever.glb
